meta.name: frontend-design
meta.description: Create distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces with high design quality. Use this skill when the user asks to build web components, pages, or applications. Generates creative, polished code that avoids generic AI aesthetics.

copy.tagline: 构建高质量前端界面与组件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速生成美观、可投产的前端代码
copy.tagline_en: Build production-grade frontend interfaces with high design quality
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly generate beautiful, production-ready frontend code

howto.what: 当你要做网页组件、页面或应用时,Claude 会先确定一个有辨识度的视觉方向,再写出可直接运行的 HTML/CSS/JS 或 React/Vue 代码,注重字体、配色、动效等细节,避开常见的通用 AI 风格。
howto.when: 当你要求做网页组件、页面、应用等前端界面时触发;提供用途、受众或技术限制等背景时,也会按此流程设计。

say.text: 做一个复古未来风格的落地页。
say.note: Claude 会先定视觉方向再写代码。

say.text: 用 React 写一个编辑感十足的文章页面。
say.note: 会给出配套的组件与动效实现。

say.text: 设计一个粗野主义风格的控制台界面。
say.note: 会按该风格统筹字体、配色与布局。

howto.what_en: On a frontend request, Claude first commits to a distinctive visual direction, then writes working code (HTML/CSS/JS, React, Vue, etc.) with careful typography, color, and motion, avoiding generic AI aesthetics.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to build a web component, page, or application; providing purpose, audience, or technical constraints also guides this process.

say_en.note: Claude sets the visual direction first, then codes.

say_en.text: Write an editorial-style article page in React.

say_en.note: Typography, color, and layout follow the style.
